name: number-counter
title: Number Counter
description: Scroll-triggered number counters with digit rolling animations (multiple variants).

changelog.summary: Added reduced-motion support and configurable animation timing.

props.name: duration
props.description: Digit roll duration in seconds for all three counters.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Delay between digit columns in seconds for all three counters.

props.name: textColor
props.description: Counter text color for all three counters.
